summary: Board-certified physician with over a decade of continuous full-time experience delivering comprehensive primary care across outpatient and community settings. Skilled in chronic disease management, preventive care, and coordinating multidisciplinary care teams to improve patient outcomes.

experience.title: Physician
bullets: Provide comprehensive primary care to a panel of approximately 2,200 patients, prescribing medications, vaccinations, and therapies for acute and chronic conditions.
Diagnose conditions by ordering and interpreting laboratory, imaging, and diagnostic tests, integrating results with patient history and examination findings.
Document patient encounters, medical histories, and treatment plans in the electronic health record, maintaining accuracy and regulatory compliance.
Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans through structured follow-up, reducing avoidable emergency department visits by 18% over two years.
Counsel patients on diet, activity, hygiene, and disease prevention, and explain test results and treatment options in accessible language.
Direct and coordinate care activities with nurses, medical assistants, and specialists to ensure continuity across the care team.
Refer patients to appropriate specialists when advanced or focused care is required, tracking outcomes and closing the loop on consultations.

experience.title: Physician
bullets: Delivered full-spectrum outpatient care to a diverse, underserved patient population, including preventive screenings and chronic disease management.
Ordered and interpreted diagnostic tests to identify conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and respiratory illness.
Prescribed and administered vaccinations, medications, and therapies in accordance with evidence-based guidelines.
Collected and maintained detailed patient records, ensuring complete medical histories and examination documentation.
Educated patients and community members on lifestyle modification, nutrition, and preventive health practices.
Supervised and mentored nursing staff and rotating students in clinical procedures and patient communication.

experience.title: Primary Care Physician
bullets: Managed a primary care panel, evaluating and treating common acute and chronic conditions in an outpatient setting.
Performed comprehensive histories and physical examinations and documented findings in patient records.
Ordered and interpreted routine laboratory and diagnostic studies to support accurate diagnosis.
Prescribed treatment regimens and monitored patient response, refining plans based on progress and test results.
Collaborated with an interdisciplinary team of nurses, therapists, and specialists to coordinate patient care.
Advised patients on hygiene, activity, and disease prevention strategies during routine visits and follow-up.

experience.title: Resident Physician
bullets: Completed supervised clinical training across outpatient, inpatient, and emergency settings.
Conducted patient interviews, examinations, and record-keeping under attending physician oversight.
Ordered and interpreted diagnostic tests and presented findings during rounds and case conferences.
Administered treatments, medications, and vaccinations while monitoring patient conditions and progress.
Explained procedures and test results to patients and provided preventive health counseling.

education.institution: a state university school of medicine
